sloka: महात्मानाम् सुदुष्प्रापम् प्राप्तम् राज्यम् इदम् प्रभो ।भवता समनुज्ञातः प्रविश्य नगरम् शुभम् ॥४-२६-५॥
transliteration: mahātmānām suduṣprāpam prāptam rājyam idam prabho ।bhavatā samanujñātaḥ praviśya nagaram śubham ॥4-26-5॥

translations.english: 'Permitted by your gracious self, he will enter the auspicious city along with his friends and perform his duties. He had his auspicious bath in fragrant waters with medicinal herbs as per tradition.
